title: Behavior Beg
description: Allows this mob to look at and follow the player that holds food they like.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

items.description: Items the entity will beg for.

look_distance.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity will look at the player.

oneOf.description: Range [min, max] of look time in seconds.

look_time.description: Time in seconds the entity will look at the player.
